title: आइजीपीमाथि दबाब बढाउँदै ‘टिम बालेन’, कानूनी परामर्शमा जुट्यो हेडक्वार्टर
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेपाल प्रहरीका महानिरीक्षक (आईजीपी) दानबहादुर कार्कीसँग सरकारले राजीनामा माग गरेको छ । कार्की भने कानुनी परामर्शमा जुटेका छन् । कार्कीमाथि प्रधानमन्त्री बालेन्द्र शाहको सचिवालयले दबाब बढाएको हो । प्रधानमन्त्रीको सचिवालयस्रोतका अनुसार संदिग्ध गतिविधिमा लागेपछि पक्राउ परेका इनम सापकोटासँग जोडेर कार्कीमाथि राजीनामाको दबाब बढाइएको हो । आइतबार नै राजीनामा दिनका लागि प्रधानमन्त्रीको सचिवालयबाट कार्कीलाई अनुरोध गरिएको स्रोतको दावी छ । सचिवालयका एक जिम्मेवार व्यक्तिले बताएअनुसार ‘राजीनामा नदिए पदबाट हटाउनुपर्ने हुनसक्छ’ भनिएको थियो । त्यसो भनेपछि उनले केही कानुन व्यवसायीसँग छलफल गर्दै पदबाट हटाइने कुरालाई अदालती प्रक्रियाबाट रोक्नका लागि परामर्श गरेका थिए । छलफलमा सहभागी एक कानुन व्यवसायीका अनुसार पदबाट हटाउनुअघि नै कुनै प्रकारको मुद्दा वा निवेदन दायर गर्दा झन् फितलो कदम हुने भएकाले यदि सरकारले हटायो भने त्यसपछि दायर गरिने मुद्दाबाट अगाडि बढ्न सकिने सुझाव दिएका थिए । प्रधानमन्त्री सचिवालयस्रोतका अनुसार सोमबार बस्नुपर्ने मन्त्रिपरिषद्को नियमित बैठक यही विषय नसुल्झिएका कारण आजसम्म बसेको छैन। सत्तारुढ राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीका सभापति रवि लामिछाने तीर्थाटनका क्रममा भारतमा भारतमा थिए । उनी फर्किएपछि बस्ने मन्त्रिपरिषद् बैठकबाट आवश्यक निर्णय गर्ने गरी बैठक सारिएको हो । कार्कीबारेको निर्णयमा रवि निर्णायक बन्न सक्ने अवस्था छ । आज बुधबार अपराह्न मन्त्रिपरिषद्को बैठक बोलाउने प्रधानमन्त्री बालेन्द्र शाहको तयारी थियो । तर, भोलि बिहीबार नियमित बैठक नै बस्ने गरी आजको बैठक भने बोलाइएन । पूर्वप्रधानन्यायाधीश चोलेन्द्रसमशेर राणाको पक्राउपछि उनको कनेक्सनका मानिसहरु खोजी गर्ने क्रममा इनम सापकोटा पक्राउ परेका थिए । सापकोटाको पक्राउपछि उनको मोबाइलको प्राविधिक परीक्षणका क्रममा पक्राउ पर्नुभन्दा ६ दिनअघि आईजीपी कार्कीसँग ह्वाट्सयापमा सम्पर्क भएको दावी गरिएको छ । यद्यपी इनम सापकोटा प्रकरण एउटा बहानामात्र भएको र बालेनको सचिवालयका केही सदस्य पहिलेदेखि नै कार्कीसँग नकारात्मक रहेकाले उपयुक्त मौकाको खोजीमा थिए । उनीहरुकै योजनामा आइजीपीविरुद्ध लेखा समितिमा बेनामी उजुरी दर्ता गरेर खगेन्द्र सुनारमार्फत उनको हुर्मत लिने प्रयास समेत भएको बताइएको छ । कार्कीले सुनारको आरोपको जवाफ दिनेक्रममा ‘हामी कस्ताबाट शासित हुन अभिशप्त छौं’ भनेका थिए । Kathmandu. The government has demanded the resignation of Inspector General of Nepal Police (IGP) Dan Bahadur Karki. Karki is currently seeking legal advice. Prime Minister Balendra Shah's secretariat has increased pressure on Karki. According to sources in the Prime Minister's Secretariat, pressure on Karki to resign has been increased by linking him to Inam Sapkota, who was arrested for engaging in suspicious activities. The source claims that Karki was requested to resign by the Prime Minister's Secretariat on Sunday itself. According to a responsible person in the secretariat, he was told that he might be removed from his post if he did not resign. After being told that, he consulted with some legal professionals to prevent his removal from the post through the court process. According to a legal practitioner who participated in the discussion, it would be a weak move to file any kind of lawsuit or petition before removal from office, so if the government removes him, he could move forward with the lawsuit filed afterwards. According to sources in the Prime Minister's Secretariat, the regular meeting of the Council of Ministers, which was scheduled to be held on Monday, has not been held till date due to the unresolved issue. Ruling National Independent Party President Ravi Lamichhane was in India on a pilgrimage. The meeting has been postponed to make the necessary decisions from the cabinet meeting that will be held after his return. Ravi is likely to be decisive in the decision regarding Karki. Prime Minister Balendra Shah was preparing to call a cabinet meeting this Wednesday afternoon. However, today's meeting was not called as the regular meeting will be held tomorrow, Thursday. Inam Sapkota was arrested while searching for his connections after the arrest of former Chief Justice Cholendra Shumsher Rana. It is claimed that during the technical examination of Sapkota's mobile phone after his arrest, he had contacted IGP Karki on WhatsApp 6 days before his arrest. However, the Inam Sapkota case was just an excuse and some members of Balen's secretariat were already negative towards Karki, so they were looking for a suitable opportunity. It is said that their plan was to file an anonymous complaint against the IGP in the Accounts Committee and try to gain his respect through Khagendra Sunar. Karki, while responding to Sunar's accusation, had said, "We are cursed to be governed by whom."

दायर गर्दा झन् फितलो कदम हुने भएकाले यदि सरकारले हटायो भने त्यसपछि दायर गरिने मुद्दाबाट अगाडि बढ्न सकिने सुझाव दिएका थिए । प्रधानमन्त्री सचिवालयस्रोतका अनुसार सोमबार बस्नुपर्ने मन्त्रिपरिषद्को नियमित गर्ने गरी बैठक सारिएको हो । कार्कीबारेको निर्णयमा रवि निर्णायक बन्न सक्ने अवस्था छ । आज बुधबार अपराह्न मन्त्रिपरिषद्को बैठक बोलाउने प्रधानमन्त्री बालेन्द्र शाहको तयारी थियो । तर, भोलि बिहीबार नियमित बैठक नै बस्ने गरी आजको बैठक भने बोलाइएन । पूर्वप्रधानन्यायाधीश चोलेन्द्रसमशेर राणाको पक्राउपछि उनको कनेक्सनका मानिसहरु खोजी गर्ने क्रममा इनम सापकोटा पक्राउ परेका थिए । सापकोटाको पक्राउपछि उनको मोबाइलको प्राविधिक परीक्षणका क्रममा पक्राउ पर्नुभन्दा ६ दिनअघि आईजीपी कार्कीसँग ह्वाट्सयापमा सम्पर्क भएको दावी गरिएको छ । यद्यपी इनम सापकोटा प्रकरण एउटा बहानामात्र भएको र बालेनको सचिवालयका केही सदस्य पहिलेदेखि नै कार्कीसँग नकारात्मक रहेकाले उपयुक्त मौकाको खोजीमा थिए । उनीहरुकै योजनामा आइजीपीविरुद्ध लेखा समितिमा बेनामी उजुरी दर्ता गरेर खगेन्द्र सुनारमार्फत उनको हुर्मत लिने प्रयास समेत भएको बताइएको छ । कार्कीले सुनारको आरोपको जवाफ दिनेक्रममा ‘हामी कस्ताबाट शासित हुन अभिशप्त छौं’ भनेका थिए । Kathmandu. The government has demanded the resignation of Inspector General of Nepal Police (IGP) Dan Bahadur Karki. Karki is currently seeking legal advice. Prime Minister Balendra Shah's secretariat has increased pressure on Karki. According to sources in the Prime Minister's Secretariat, pressure on Karki to resign has been increased by linking him to Inam Sapkota, who was arrested for engaging in suspicious activities. The meeting has been postponed to make the necessary decisions from the cabinet meeting that will be held after his return. Ravi is likely to be decisive in the decision regarding Karki. प्रधानमन्त्रीको सचिवालयस्रोतका अनुसार संदिग्ध गतिविधिमा लागेपछि पक्राउ परेका इनम सापकोटासँग जोडेर कार्कीमाथि राजीनामाको दबाब बढाइएको हो । आइतबार नै राजीनामा दिनका लागि प्रधानमन्त्रीको सचिवालयबाट कार्कीलाई अनुरोध गरिएको स्रोतको दावी छ ।

सचिवालयका एक जिम्मेवार व्यक्तिले बताएअनुसार ‘राजीनामा नदिए पदबाट हटाउनुपर्ने हुनसक्छ’ भनिएको थियो । त्यसो भनेपछि उनले केही कानुन व्यवसायीसँग छलफल गर्दै पदबाट हटाइने कुरालाई अदालती प्रक्रियाबाट रोक्नका लागि परामर्श गरेका थिए ।

छलफलमा सहभागी एक कानुन व्यवसायीका अनुसार पदबाट हटाउनुअघि नै कुनै प्रकारको मुद्दा वा निवेदन दायर गर्दा झन् फितलो कदम हुने भएकाले यदि सरकारले हटायो भने त्यसपछि दायर गरिने मुद्दाबाट अगाडि बढ्न सकिने सुझाव दिएका थिए ।

प्रधानमन्त्री सचिवालयस्रोतका अनुसार सोमबार बस्नुपर्ने मन्त्रिपरिषद्को नियमित बैठक यही विषय नसुल्झिएका कारण आजसम्म बसेको छैन। सत्तारुढ राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीका सभापति रवि लामिछाने तीर्थाटनका क्रममा भारतमा भारतमा थिए ।

उनी फर्किएपछि बस्ने मन्त्रिपरिषद् बैठकबाट आवश्यक निर्णय गर्ने गरी बैठक सारिएको हो । कार्कीबारेको निर्णयमा रवि निर्णायक बन्न सक्ने अवस्था छ । आज बुधबार अपराह्न मन्त्रिपरिषद्को बैठक बोलाउने प्रधानमन्त्री बालेन्द्र शाहको तयारी थियो । तर, भोलि बिहीबार नियमित बैठक नै बस्ने गरी आजको बैठक भने बोलाइएन ।

पूर्वप्रधानन्यायाधीश चोलेन्द्रसमशेर राणाको पक्राउपछि उनको कनेक्सनका मानिसहरु खोजी गर्ने क्रममा इनम सापकोटा पक्राउ परेका थिए । सापकोटाको पक्राउपछि उनको मोबाइलको प्राविधिक परीक्षणका क्रममा पक्राउ पर्नुभन्दा ६ दिनअघि आईजीपी कार्कीसँग ह्वाट्सयापमा सम्पर्क भएको दावी गरिएको छ ।

यद्यपी इनम सापकोटा प्रकरण एउटा बहानामात्र भएको र बालेनको सचिवालयका केही सदस्य पहिलेदेखि नै कार्कीसँग नकारात्मक रहेकाले उपयुक्त मौकाको खोजीमा थिए । उनीहरुकै योजनामा आइजीपीविरुद्ध लेखा समितिमा बेनामी उजुरी दर्ता गरेर खगेन्द्र सुनारमार्फत उनको हुर्मत लिने प्रयास समेत भएको बताइएको छ । कार्कीले सुनारको आरोपको जवाफ दिनेक्रममा ‘हामी कस्ताबाट शासित हुन अभिशप्त छौं’ भनेका थिए ।

According to sources in the Prime Minister's Secretariat, pressure on Karki to resign has been increased by linking him to Inam Sapkota, who was arrested for engaging in suspicious activities. The source claims that Karki was requested to resign by the Prime Minister's Secretariat on Sunday itself. According to a responsible person in the secretariat, he was told that he might be removed from his post if he did not resign. After being told that, he consulted with some legal professionals to prevent his removal from the post through the court process. According to a legal practitioner who participated in the discussion, it would be a weak move to file any kind of lawsuit or petition before removal from office, so if the government removes him, he could move forward with the lawsuit filed afterwards. According to sources in the Prime Minister's Secretariat, the regular meeting of the Council of Ministers, which was scheduled to be held on Monday, has not been held till date due to the unresolved issue. Ruling National Independent Party President Ravi Lamichhane was in India on a pilgrimage. The meeting has been postponed to make the necessary decisions from the cabinet meeting that will be held after his return. Ravi is likely to be decisive in the decision regarding Karki. Prime Minister Balendra Shah was preparing to call a cabinet meeting this Wednesday afternoon. However, today's meeting was not called as the regular meeting will be held tomorrow, Thursday. Inam Sapkota was arrested while searching for his connections after the arrest of former Chief Justice Cholendra Shumsher Rana. It is claimed that during the technical examination of Sapkota's mobile phone after his arrest, he had contacted IGP Karki on WhatsApp 6 days before his arrest. However, the Inam Sapkota case was just an excuse and some members of Balen's secretariat were already negative towards Karki, so they were looking for a suitable opportunity. It is said that their plan was to file an anonymous complaint against the IGP in the Accounts Committee and try to gain his respect through Khagendra Sunar. Karki, while responding to Sunar's accusation, had said, "We are cursed to be governed by whom."
